senses.gloss: यात् 1. yā́-t, pr. pt. √ yā, moving etc..

यात् 2. yā́t, ab. (of rel. yá), ad. cj. (V.) as 🞄far as;
 as long as, while.
यत ya-tá, pp. (√ yam) restrained etc.: (a)- 🞄gir, a. restraining speech, silent.
यतनीय yat-anīya, fp. n. imps. one should 🞄strive after (lc.).

यतम ya-tamá, a. (n. -d) who or which of 🞄many (V.);
 -tará, a. (n. -d) which of two (V.).

यतवाच् yata-vāc, a. restraining oneʼs speech, 🞄silent;
 -vrata, a. firm of purpose.
यतस्रुच् yatá-sruc, a. having an outstretched 🞄ladle (RV.).
यतात्मन् yata‿ātman, a. having oneʼs mind 🞄concentrated, controlled oneself.
यति 1. yá-ti, a. pl. (nm. ac. yáti) as many as.

यति 2. yát-i, m. disposer (V.): pl. N. of 🞄an ancient race connected with the Bhṛgus;
 🞄sg. (striver), one who has renounced the world, 🞄ascetic, anchorite.
यतिचान्द्रायण yati-cāndrāyaṇa, n. kind of 🞄penance.
यतितव्य yat-i-tavya, fp. n. one should 🞄exert oneself, for (lc.).

यतिथ yati-thá, a. (ī́) the how-manieth (Br.);
 🞄-dhā́, ad. in how many parts or places (AV.).
यतिन् yat-in, m. ascetic.
यतिभ्रष्ट yati-bhraṣṭa, pp. lacking the requisite 🞄caesura.
यतोमूल yato-mūla, a. originating in which.

यत्नवत् yatna-vat, a. possessed of volition;
 🞄taking trouble, exerting oneself (with lc.).

यत्रकामावसाय yatra-kāma‿avasāya, m. 🞄magical power of transferring oneself anywhere 🞄at will;
 -tatra-śaya, a. lying down 🞄anywhere, not minding where one sleeps.
यत्रत्य yatra-tya, a. being or dwelling in 🞄which place.
यातयज्जन yātayáj-jana, a. marshalling 🞄the people, arousing men to activity (RV.).
यातवे yā́-tave, d. inf. to travel.

यातव्य yā-tavya, fp. to be gone against, — 🞄attacked;
 n. imps. one should go, start, or 🞄march: d. for departure.

यातायात yāta‿āyā́ta, n. going and coming;
 🞄ebb and flood.

यातु yā-tú, m. [√ yā: attack], (V.) sorcery;
 🞄kind of fiend: -dhā́na, m., ī, f. kind of 🞄fiend or goblin.
यातृ 2. yā-tṛ́, m. [pursuer: √ yā], avenger 🞄(RV.¹).
यातृ 3. yā-tṛ, f. wife of husbandʼs brother.
यात्रोत्सव yātra‿utsava, m. festive train, 🞄procession.
